narrative.overview: Mars is a planet, so a circle runs the entire page. It appears at three wildly different scales and never in another shape: a 128vh orb cropped by three viewport edges behind the hero, the round press of every button and plate, the circular frame the stage captures sit in, the star dots in the field, and the knob on every switch. One geometry, committed, is the whole system. Sections are plain single or two-column layouts precisely so the circle is the only thing with character. The world is deep space: near-black ground with stars, rust as the one warm light. The field is a drawn layer at 50% opacity, it drifts over ninety seconds, and the orb carries the single photograph the page needs: NASA JPL-Caltech PIA17947, Mount Sharp on the Martian horizon, multiplied into the rust with the ground veil baked in so bone type clears AA over it.
keyCharacteristics: One motif, the circle, at hero, component and texture scale. No second shape.
Rust on near-black, and nothing else: no second hue, no gradient fill, no shadow.
Soft, fully rounded controls against a hard photographic orb.

Motion is the page's voice: a clip-wipe entrance, staggered children, a scroll-driven drift and lean, a live switch, and a slider that redraws the section. Every one has a reduced-motion path that leaves the content complete.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Rust is the only warm colour and the only accent. A second hue is a different world.

rules.name: The Mark, Not the Read Rule
rules.body: Rust never sets a sentence. It sets a sigil, a fill, a dot, a thumb.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: No second face, no italic, no serif accent word. Emphasis is weight and size.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing meant to be read drops under 16px.

rules.name: The Equal Margin Rule
rules.body: Both gutters are the same everywhere. A crop is the only thing allowed past them.

rules.name: The No Empty Half Rule
rules.body: Every wide layout closes its far side with the orb, the picture, the switch, or a second column.

rules.name: The One Shape Rule
rules.body: A circle at hero, control, texture and frame scale. A square is only the board grid.

rules.name: The Content-First Rule
rules.body: No entrance may hide content that the script has not already revealed, and reduced motion shows the finished frame.

rules.name: The Live-Focus Rule
rules.body: An action that moves focus names its destination tab first; focus never lands on a panel that is hidden.

dos: Keep one motif and one light.
Round every control fully; round plates at 1.35rem.
Set machine facts in <code> and everything else in Pilcrow Rounded.
Keep every control at least 44px tall and give it a visible focus ring.
Add motion with a transform or opacity, and give it a reduced-motion path.
Keep bone copy at 4.5:1 over the orb; re-bake the veil into the asset when the disc moves under the type.
Put anything that travels to the clipboard in <code> alone, never beside a decorative sigil.
donts: Add a second shape, a second accent, a gradient fill, or a shadow.
Set anything meant to be read under 16px.
Let the orb cover the headline at any width.
Add decorative numbering or an eyebrow above a heading.
